senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; חָרַשׁ I)artist, artisan, carpenter, turner (faber).
units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:30">Deut. R. s. 2</cite> <he>לח׳ שהיה וכ׳</he> like an artist that was making an image &c.—Pl. <he>חָרָשִׁים</he>.
Gen. R. s. 65, end; s. 70, v. חֲמוֹר; Pesik. Shek., p. 15ᵃ.—Trsnf. scholar.
Gitt. 88ᵃ (ref. to II Kings XXIV, 16) חָ׳ שבשעה … כחֵרְשִׁין the scholars were named ḥarash, for when they opened argument, all were like dumb; Snh. 38ᵃ; Yalk. Dan. 1066; a. e.—Pl. as above.
